messages:
maria: hey all :wave: I'm on my first week and trying to get CI running for my PR. hitting a Buildkite token error when I try to trigger a pipeline — anyone know who to ping or what I missed? Here's the error I see when I try to trigger from my laptop:
```
2026-05-03T15:12:03Z ERROR: Buildkite API: 403 Forbidden - Invalid API token
```
I reconnected the GitHub app but PR builds still didn't trigger.

oliver: welcome! pinged infra-admins. did you accept the repo invite and add your SSH key? sometimes clone/trigger problems come from that.

maria: I accepted the invite. I also tried `buildkite-agent pipeline upload` locally and got: 
```
Error: POST https://api.buildkite.com/v2/organizations/redwood/pipelines/ci/builds: 403 - Invalid API token
```

sam: are you using a personal Buildkite token? We use org-scoped service tokens for manual triggers. New hires get added to the buildkite-team and we map a service token. @jess can provision.

jess: I can add you to buildkite-team. need your GitHub username + email. also check the onboarding doc: https://redwood-internal.link/ci-onboarding (has step-by-step).

maria: github username mariat-redwood, email m.t@redwood.com

jess: ok adding you now. one sec :white_check_mark:

devex-bot: buildkite: membership updated for mariat-redwood -> buildkite-team

maria: thanks! retried the pipeline. it triggers now but the job fails during checkout: 
```
Cloning into 'repo'...
Permission denied (publickey).
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
```

oliver: yep that's SSH key / agent issue. make sure your public key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub) is uploaded to GitHub and your ssh-agent is running. If you prefer HTTPS to avoid SSH keys: `git remote set-url origin https://github.com/redwood/repo.git`.

maria: I uploaded the key and restarted the agent. checkout passes now but unit tests fail in the pipeline with: `Cannot find secret 'CI_DOCKER_TOKEN'`. I think GH Actions steps need org secrets or repo-level access.

sam: note: GitHub Actions vs Buildkite — in our mono-repo some jobs run in GH Actions for certain steps and those use org-level secrets. If your PR is from a fork those secrets are not provided for security reasons. Are you opening the PR from a fork?

maria: ah 🤦 I originally forked the repo before joining. I pushed changes to my fork. I can push the branch directly to the main repo and open a PR from there.

maria: repushed branch to redwood/repo and opened a new PR — build triggered and looks green now :tada:

oliver: nice! I'll add the short checklist to the onboarding doc so future new hires see it: 1) accept repo invites, 2) add SSH key and run ssh-agent, 3) request buildkite-team membership (jess), 4) be mindful forks lose org secrets, 5) ask devex for token provisioning if you need manual triggers.

maria: huge thanks everyone — learned a lot. tagging follow-ups: @jess for buildkite token, @sam for GH secrets docs, @oliver for devex onboarding updates.
